title: Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.07048v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evolution has shaped intelligence for billions of years. Artificial intelligence (AI) now raises a striking possibility: intelligence may begin to direct its own evolution. As AI agents become capable of modifying and evaluating their own behavior, how quickly could they improve, and how can that improvement remain safe? We develop a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian, and agent-directed evolution following environmental change. Darwinian evolution relies on natural selection, Lamarckian evolution adds inherited learning, and agent-directed evolution allows agents to generate and evaluate behavioral variants and choose how extensively to search. When learning is sufficiently effective, these mechanisms exhibit progressively faster adaptation. translated_title: 调适适应的进程：人工智能中的达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体导向演化
translated_abstract: 演化在数十亿年间塑造了智能。人工智能（AI）如今提出了一个引人注目的可能性：智能或许会开始引导自身的演化。当AI智能体变得能够修改并评估自身行为时，它们能以多快的速度改进？这种改进又如何保持安全？我们建立了一个理论框架，比较环境变化之后的三种演化方式：达尔文式演化依赖自然选择，拉马克式演化在此基础上加入了可遗传的学习，而智能体导向演化则允许智能体生成并评估行为变体，并自主决定搜索的深度。当学习足够有效时，这些机制表现出逐级加快的适应速度。生成更多变体可以加速适应，而最优搜索努力取决于学习能力、问题难度和实验成本。然而，智能体的能力……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个比较达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体导向演化的理论框架，发现当学习足够有效时三种机制的适应速度依次加快，生成更多变体可加速适应，而最优搜索努力取决于学习能力、问题难度与实验成本。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian, and agent-directed evolution, showing that when learning is sufficiently effective, these mechanisms exhibit progressively faster adaptation, with more variants accelerating adaptation and optimal search effort depending on learning ability, problem difficulty, and experimentation costs.
